purpose: Voorkom stale branch reuse, dubbele semantische PR-owners en ambigue successor-state in de deliveryketen.

knownFailure.symptom: Multiple chats/agents mutate one active PR branch while exact-head gates are running, repeatedly superseding valid evidence.
knownFailure.rootCause: Canonical PR/obligation ownership lacked a mandatory terminal writer lease inherited by every chat/agent preflight.
knownFailure.failedApproach: Allow unrelated or opportunistic commits on a canonical branch during TERMINAL_DELIVERY.
knownFailure.fix: Require one obligation-scoped writer lease in mandatory preflight; non-owner workers defer until release.
